# Vendored dependencies

These are exact tagged snapshots used by `hanzo-chain` and `hanzod`. They are
vendored so CI does not need credentials for the private `lux-rs` GitHub repos.

- `lux-node` — v0.2.2, commit `c1e764b91a322caf09edd9cf5515244725150376`
- `lux-evm` — v0.1.2, commit `1f54eeec53b24887c349c89d73347c8e4ab59cad`

Both are mirrored at the same tags on `git.hanzo.ai` under `lux-rs/`. Refresh
from the forge mirror, not from GitHub.
